subject: PICTURE clause
notes: LANDED 2026-09-09 (kb/Work PB528). The FIRST sentence (the comma is the decimal separator, the period the grouping separator) was already live at edit time via CobolEdit.MaskScale. The SECOND - 'The rules for the symbol period apply to the symbol comma, and the rules for the symbol comma apply to the symbol period' - was VACUOUS, because the period-specific composition rules it transfers did not exist. They do now, and the transfer is a PARAMETER of the one validator rather than a comma copy of every period rule: PictureAnalyzer.Analyze takes decimalPointIsComma from DataBinder and PictureComposition reads which character is the decimal separator for SR12b, SR17, SR20 and for the Table-10 roles (13.18.40.6: 'When the DECIMAL-POINT IS COMMA clause is specified, the precedence rules for the symbols comma and period are interchanged'). Both directions measured: PIC 9V9,9 and PIC PP99,99 are COBOL1934 in comma mode (SR20 and SR17 transferred) while PIC 9.999.999,99 and PIC ZZ.ZZZ.ZZZ,99 - NIST NC107A and SM103A shapes, with TWO grouping periods each - compile and render 1.234.567,89 and '     1.234,50'. Without the flag those two NIST shapes are rejected as legal source, which is exactly what the drift test pins.
